2645-3430-3756-7014.easyPrerequisites: North Pole Patrol doesn't have summoning sickness.
2645-3430-3756-7014.description:
Activate Izzet Boilerworks by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}{R}{R}{R} due to Nyxbloom Ancient
Activate North Pole Patrol by tapping it, untapping Izzet Boilerworks
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping North Pole Patrol.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

6-950-5261.easyPrerequisites:
Vitalize is exiled by Isochron Scepter.
Fatestitcher doesn't have summoning sickness.
Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {2}.
6-950-5261.description:
Activate any number of creatures by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of Vitalize without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Vitalize, untapping all creatures you control
Activate Fatestitcher by tapping it, untapping Isochron Scepter.
Repeat.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

2023-4770-5434-6006.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying its mana cost.
Aragorn triggers, creating a 1/1 Human Soldier creature token.
When Whitemane Lion enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Whitemane Lion and the Human Soldier token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

549-2099-6871--211.easyPrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast the earthbend creature.
549-2099-6871--211.description:
Cast the earthbend creature by paying its mana cost.
When the creature enters, it triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's an artifact due to Biotransference, thus making it also a land due to Toph.
Activate Sarcatog by sacrificing the earthbent creature.
When the creature dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the creature enters, it triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's an artifact due to Biotransference, thus making it also a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Sarcatog ability, giving Sarcatog +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat from step 3.
549-2099-6871--211.notes: Depending on the earthbend creature used, you may receive additional results. There may also be needed prerequisites that are specific for each card (such as Bumi, King of Three Trials which requires a Lesson in your graveyard).

628-2018-4991.description:
Activate Whisperwood Elemental by sacrificing it.
When Whisperwood Elemental dies, Mikaeus triggers, returning Whisperwood Elemental from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Whisperwood Elemental ability
Activate Whisperwood Elemental by sacrificing it.
When Whisperwood Elemental dies, Luminous Broodmoth triggers, returning Whisperwood Elemental from your graveyard to the battlefield with a flying counter on it.
Resolve the Whisperwood Elemental ability
Repeat

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more lore counters on it

1479-2841-7885-8102.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Windswept Heath.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
1479-2841-7885-8102.description:
Fetch a land using Windswept Heath.
When the fetched land enters, Down in the Valley and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Down in the Valley trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Down in the Valley from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Down in the Valley triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

648-7887.description:
Cast Body of Research by paying {G}{G}{G}{U}{U}{U}, creating a 0/0 Fractal creature token and putting a number of +1/+1 counters on it equal to the number of cards in your library.
Cast Last March of the Ents by paying {6}{G}{G}, drawing your entire library and putting all creature cards from your hand and library onto the battlefield.

2034-4460-6970-7763-7850.description:
Cast Abby from the command zone by paying {1}{R}{G} plus commander tax if applicable.
Abby triggers, creating a number of 1/1 Fungus Zombie creature tokens named Cordyceps Infected equal to the amount of mana spent to cast it.
When Abby enters under an opponent's control, Mirror of Life Trapping triggers, exiling Abby.
Choose to return Abby from exile to the command zone.
Activate two Codryceps Infected tokens by tapping them, adding {R}{G}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Cordyceps Infected token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat step 6 until you have enough mana to cast Abby.
Repeat from step 1.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Radiant Solar
as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-1619-1974-2665.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-1619-1974-2665.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Quicksilver Gargantuan and Progenitor Mimic each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Quicksilver Gargantuan trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Progenitor Mimic trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-1619-1974-2665.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

849-1580-4871-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton.
When Reassembling Skeleton dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Anax trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

240-2438-5470-7175.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Carrion Feeder
Repeat from step 2.

2782-7299.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to kill Nevinyrral
2782-7299.description:
Kill Nevinyrral. When it dies, it triggers, causing you to pay {1} to destroy all artifacts, creatures and enchantments.
Cast Biorhythm by paying its mana cost, causing each player's life total to become equal to the number of creatures they control.
Each player that controls no creatures loses the game due to having 0 life.
2782-7299.notes: You will also lose the game if you control no creatures as Biorhythm resolves, causing the game to end in a draw. You can avoid this by putting a creature onto the battlefield after step 1, or by having an indestructible creature. Similarly, any opponent who controls an indestructible creature will not have 0 life or lose the game.

Activate Aether Spellbomb's second ability by paying {1} and sacrificing it, causing you to draw a card.

When the basic land enters, Amulet of Vigor, Lotus Cobra and Bristly Bill trigger.
Resolve the Amulet of Vigor trigger, untapping the basic land.
Resolve the Lotus Cobra trigger, adding {G}.
Resolve the Bristly Bill trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Fertilid.
Activate the basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

3043-5090.notablePrerequisites: You control at least seven creatures with defender.
3043-5090.description:
Activate Axebane Guardian by tapping it, adding at least seven mana of any color
Activate Singing Bell Strike by paying {6}, untapping Axebane Guardian.
Repeat.

3518-4195-4574-6766.description:
Activate Lion's Eye Diamond by discarding your hand and sacrificing it.
Ich-Tekik's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and each Golem you control.
Activate Arcbound Reclaimer by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting Lion's Eye Diamond from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Cast Lion's Eye Diamond from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat.

2173-2459-5220-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Rograkh
When Rograkh dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Rograkh from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Cast Rograkh from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
Repeat.

478-3053-6871.notablePrerequisites: There are at least three basic land types among lands you control
478-3053-6871.description:
Activate Prismatic Geoscope by tapping it, adding at least {3}.
Activate Candelabra of Tawnos by paying {2} and tapping it, untapping Prismatic Geoscope and Candelabra of Tawnos as they are lands due to Toph.
Repeat.

Activate Sidisi by tapping it and sacrificing the creature with mana value 0.
When the creature dies, Sidisi triggers, untapping Sidisi.
Resolve the Sidisi ability, returning the creature that creates creature token(s) on death from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the creature.
When the creature dies, it and Sidisi trigger.
Resolve the Sidisi trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the creature's trigger, creating at least one creature token.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

1274-3490-4659-6752.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1274-3490-4659-6752.description:
Gain life.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters the battlefield, Haliya triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Heliod triggers, holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Heliod trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Repeat from step 3.

474-4394-5231-5929.description:
Cast Everquill Phoenix for its mutate cost by paying {3}{R}, putting it under or over a non-Human creature you control.
Everquill Phoenix triggers, creating a Feather artifact token.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Specimen Collector, adding {R}.
When Specimen Collector dies, its second ability triggers, creating a copy of the Feather token.
Activate a Feather by paying {1} and sacrificing it, returning Specimen Collector from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Specimen Collector enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Squirrel and a 0/3 Crab creature token.
Repeat from step 3.

654-2921-5222-6644.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Ancient Adamantoise.
When Ancient Adamantoise dies, it and Sword of the Realms trigger.
Resolve the Sword of the Realms trigger, returning Ancient Adamantoise from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Ancient Adamantoise trigger, creating ten tapped Treasure tokens.
When the Treasures enter, Amulet of Vigor triggers ten times, untapping the Treasures.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {6}{G}{G}{G}{W}.
Cast Ancient Adamantoise by paying {5}{G}{G}{G}.
Activate Sword of the Realms by paying {1}{W}, attaching it to Ancient Adamantoise.
Repeat.

4067-5116-6281-6435.easyPrerequisites: There are four or more permanent cards in your graveyard.
4067-5116-6281-6435.description:
Activate Gilded Lotus by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding Coati Scavenger.
Hashaton triggers, causing you to pay {2}{U} to create a tapped token copy of Coati Scavenger that is a 4/4 Zombie.
When the Coati Scavenger token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Coati Scavenger from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Mind Over Matter ability, untapping Gilded Lotus.
Repeat.

During the opponent's turn, activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing a face-down creature you control.
When the creature dies, Yarus's second ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a 2/2 creature, and then not turning it face-up due to Karlov Watchdog.
When the creature enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 2.
Repeat from step 2.

Greenweaver Druid and Pili-Pala exiled with a brain counter on them.

Activate Rex using Pili-Pala's ability by paying {2} and untapping it, adding one mana of any color.

1289-1395-5078-5864.description:
Activate Birds of Paradise by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top from the battlefield onto the top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Elsha of the Infinite's prowess ability and Valley Floodcaller trigger.
Resolve the Valley Floodcaller trigger, giving Birds, Otters, Frogs and Rats you control +1/+1 until end of turn and untapping them.
Resolve the Elsha of the Infinite trigger, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat.

2316-2557-4871.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two Goblins.
2316-2557-4871.description:
Activate Goblin Warrens by paying {2}{R} and sacrificing two Goblins.
When the Goblins die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating four Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Goblin Warrens ability, creating six 1/1 Goblin creature tokens.
Activate three Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{R}.
Repeat.

4499-4605-5423-5542.description:
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Swashbuckler Extraordinaire.
When Swashbuckler Extraordinaire enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, and Preston trigger twice if it has power 2 or less, or once otherwise.
Resolve both Swashbuckler Extraordinaire triggers, creating two Treasure artifact tokens.
Resolve the first Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Swashbuckler Extraordinaire that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Swashbuckler Extraordinaire token enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Repeat from step 4 for the remaining Preston trigger, if applicable.
Activate three Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}.
Repeat.

116-1283-1491-4417.notablePrerequisites:
Sinking Feeling attached to Kiora's Follower.
Kiora's Follower does not have summoning sickness.
116-1283-1491-4417.description:
Activate Chromatic Orrery's first ability by tapping it, adding {5}.
Activate Kiora's Follower by tapping it, untapping Chromatic Orrery.
Activate Kiora's Follower by paying {1} and putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Activate Hex Parasite by paying {2}, removing the -1/-1 counter from Kiora's Follower and giving Hex Parasite +1/+0 until end of turn.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may instead use Chromatic Orrery's first ability to draw infinite cards.

719-2034-3496-4071.description:
Cast Dread Slaver by paying {3}{B}{B}.
When Dread Slaver enters the battlefield, Be'lakor's second ability triggers, causing Dread Slaver to deal damage equal to its power to itself.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Dread Slaver, adding {C}{C}.
When Dread Slaver dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

859-4481.notablePrerequisites:
Heavy Arbalest attached to Lurking Roper.
You have a way to give Lurking Roper lifelink.
Lurking Roper does not have summoning sickness.
859-4481.description:
Give Lurking Roper lifelink, if needed.
Activate Lurking Roper by tapping it, dealing 2 damage to any target and causing you to gain 2 life.
Lurking Roper triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat from step 2.

On the end step prior to your turn, activate Reflection of Kiki-Jiki by paying {1} and tapping it.

Resolve the Reflection of Kiki-Jiki's ability, creating a token copy of other Reflection of Kiki-Jiki.
Activate a Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}.
